reason: A graphical DSH settings-panel utility for viewing and managing MCP services, Skills, and built-in plugin package metadata, including configuration changes and recoverable Skill removal.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板中查看并管理 MCP 服务、Skills 和内置插件包，支持配置启停、删除及可恢复的 Skill 移入回收站。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness settings-panel utility for viewing and managing MCP services, Skills, and built-in plugin packages, including configuration toggles, entry removal, and recoverable Skill trashing.

capabilities: reads DSH MCP, Skills, and installed plugin package metadata
enables or disables MCP service configuration entries
moves Skills directories into a timestamped trash directory
writes configuration files and creates backups before writes
